rationale: Computed total impedance at each fault by adding source, transformer, and feeder impedance to the fault point. The near bus fault gives the maximum three-phase current, the remote end fault gives the minimum two-phase current, 12.5 kA is the smallest standard breaker rating above 1.1 times the maximum fault current, and 600 A is between the 450 A load-margin minimum and the 754.055 A sensitivity maximum.
